address: Avenida de la Zurriola 1, Donostia / San Sebastián, 20002, Spain
bio: This restaurant, featuring a Nordic-inspired design, pleasant terrace, views of the mouth of the Urumea river and the hallmark of chef Andoni Luis Aduriz, is part of the ever-busy Karsaal congress centre. Here, relaxed unpretentious cuisine and grilled vegetables take centre stage (choose between the à la carte, a tasting menu, and daily specials). We can highly recommend the leeks with a meat emulsion and the grilled monkfish with Ezpeleta butter and carrots (in season only). If you eat at the bar counter you can watch your food being prepared in front of you....
